description: [structures] Moon mining end to end by a real EVE client: a Gaze survey probe on Amamake moon 40161466 (OnMoonScanComplete must match the refinery's GetMoonResourcesForStructure), an Athanor deployed at that moon's mining beacon with a Moon Drill, StartNewExtraction, the scheduling window's GM 'ready' button (/extraction advance ready) with the chunk ball moving to the refinery in the client, the Fire button (FractureChunkWithStructure), a Retriever mining a rock of the field, and the ore refined in the Athanor through the reprocessing window's calls. Needs the client-agent patch and a moon composition pack in the server's game store.

setup.note: a pilot of its own on its own account
GM setup: Heron, Survey Probe Launcher II, Gaze probes

setup.clientEval: up_build_a(35835, 'Reg Moon Athanor', warp_to=1040161466) and None
setup.note: the Athanor at the moon's mining beacon
the refinery's moon ores are what the probe reported

setup.clientEval: sm.GetService('slash').SlashCmd('/extraction advance ready'); up_sleep(4000); bp = up_bp(); [k for k in bp.slimItems if 7100000000000 < k < 7200000000000 and bp.DistanceBetween(agent.up_current['structureID'], k) < 200000] != []
setup.note: the chunk ball is beside the refinery in the client
fired: the chunk explodes into a field of rocks

setup.clientEval: up_release(); up_miner(); up_undock(); agent.up_rock = up_field_rocks(session.shipid)[0][1]; up_slash('/tr me %d' % agent.up_rock)
setup.note: GM setup: Retriever with two Strip Miner I; GM move onto the field

setup.clientEval: [sm.GetService('invCache').GetInventoryFromId(session.structureid).Add(i.itemID, session.shipid, qty=i.stacksize, flag=const.flagHangar) for i in sm.GetService('invCache').GetInventoryFromId(session.shipid).List() if i.categoryID == 25]; up_sleep(3000); len(up_reprocess([t for t, n, q in up_ore_hold()] or [i.typeID for i in up_hangar_items() if i.categoryID == 25])['out']) > 0
setup.note: refined in the Athanor: minerals out

expect.note: the client changed session (docked, undocked or moved); the clientEval asserts carry the checks
